question: Does a content-sensitive learned factual memory-write mechanism better retain stable causal effects and update changed effects after hidden interventions than competent conventional equal-state methods?

hypothesis.predicted: Four-parameter learned residual-gated 16x16 TTT factual memory achieves at least 10% lower post-switch OOD development MSE than every eligible, nonprivileged 256-float adaptive-state competitor, repeated across three distinct model seeds and three distinct OOD synthetic source cohorts.
hypothesis.null: No reproducible improvement over strongest competent conventional control after matching facts, executed actions, source family, state budget and whole-process resource accounting.
hypothesis.primary_failure: A single failed registered eligibility gate or failed primary seed/cohort comparison is DEV_FAIL; do not substitute a weaker comparator or re-tune using consumed holdout.

source.domain: Continuous 16D numeric action-to-observed-effect physical simulator; no tokenization, transformer, language next-token objective, oracle world labels or time/phase features exposed to learner.
fixed_world_generation: For each world draw a QR-orthogonal 16D action basis, select eight basis vectors as factual target action directions; independently sample each role's initial bounded 16D causal effect, without exposing basis identity or role labels.

Independently resample four of the eight target-role effect vectors at one hidden within-world change point; remaining four roles retain their original causal effect. Opposite executed action sign negates measured effect.

FIT/VAL use 96 uniformly interleaved historical factual interventions per world: 48 target-direction exposures (six per role) and 48 unique one-shot distractor actions. OOD uses 96: 32 target exposures (four per role) and 64 unique distractors.

Sample target-role intervention signs independently and balance +/- within role where possible; sample distractor directions independently and continuously, and generate their outcomes from independently sampled bounded effects.
Select hidden intervention change point uniformly from event indices 30..66 inclusive, independently of action identity, role, query and future outcomes; no fixed phase marker is visible.

For each world choose one final actually executed +/- target action AFTER the historical stream. Query sampled 50/50 from changed vs stable roles, and uniformly across the eligible roles. The actual observed final consequence is evaluation truth only and never used to write memory before scoring.

FIT/VAL factual effect noise sigma=0.03 and action jitter sigma=0.04; OOD effect noise sigma=0.06 and action jitter sigma=0.12, with independently generated world bases and maps; the OOD source has greater distraction and fewer repeated target exposures.

All methods consume exactly the same ordered realized (executed 16D action, observed 16D consequence) pairs within each world; no counterfactual outcomes, relevance labels, future query, change-point or phase information allowed in writes.

candidate.label: learned_residual_TTT_gate
candidate.reads: factual-only historical (a,y); final a only at scoring
candidate.initialization: three distinct registered model seeds; no data-dependent init adjustment
candidate.fit: frozen AdamW, lr=0.005, batch=32, 600 optimizer updates maximum; checkpoint every 50; best VALIDATION MSE; stop if nonfinite or cost budget exceeded

comparators.condition: original fixed 16x16 fast factual matrix, gate=1, same executed actions/effects; no time/phase labels
8x(16 key+16 effect), count embedded in key norm, cosine matching threshold .98; no hidden labels
P69 exact blob bf12bd3525230ecf58ecc43837f67fdf23578f35; 8x(16 key+16 effect) with previous miss slot encoded by key norm-2, true round-robin eviction, hit does not advance
TTT fixed gate with fixed validation-only grid [.1,.3,.5,.7,.9] for residual threshold; freeze before OOD
TTT fixed gate with fixed validation-only grid [.1,.3,.5,.7,.9] for read-energy threshold; freeze before OOD
GRU hidden width 256, trained with same factual source and actual query objective, independent from candidate training; no OOD selection; disclose fixed-parameter count and full-training compute

independent recurrent state width 256 with continuous numeric inputs; if implementation unavailable or incompetent report NOT_ELIGIBLE, never claim 'strongest conventional' without specifying exclusion
uniform zero outcome reference for competence thresholds

diagnostics_not_eligible.reason: hidden change labels inaccessible to real learner
negative control that substitutes independent action identity while preserving observed outcome, all else matched
negative control matched to candidate FIT write acceptance rate, no validation/holdout leakage

baseline_validity: Verify original P69 7/7 exact-blob tests plus fresh-source factual, independent seed, no-lookahead, ring-reference, bitwise cold restore and intervention-shift audit tests before any DEV OOD score.

GRU and SSM baseline recipes and compute limits pinned before FIT training; no re-tuning to OOD; baseline must beat VAL zero MSE by >=25% and show last-three checkpoint MSE spread <= 0.01 absolute to qualify.

At least one independently trained GRU or SSM baseline must be validation-competent, or strict combined DEV FAIL and no OOD scoring; missing SSM is a disclosed missing-competitor limitation even if GRU passes.
Candidate must beat VAL zero MSE by >=15% in all three seeds with finite loss and a best validation checkpoint; otherwise no OOD scoring.

All measures for equal state (adaptive float state), static weights, runtime action history, optimizer state, training/inference wall time, peak RAM and estimated FLOPs reported separately; a non-256 control cannot be included as an equal-state comparator.

training_controls.early_stop: on four non-improving validation checkpoints after at least 200 updates, but only if stationary checkpoint spread <=0.01; otherwise 600 hard limit and nonconvergence flag

outcome.primary: post-hidden-switch final factual executed action 16D mean squared effect error, stratified by changed vs stable causal role
secondary: prequential factual effect error after each completed observation
post-switch recovery delay in number of informative executed interventions
full-process total compute, peak memory and wall clock
outcome.eligiblity_freeze: all conventional-model eligibility and fixed baselines on FIT/VAL before any OOD cohort scoring
outcome.strongest_baseline: lowest per-cohort MSE among all eligible nonprivileged baselines; do not exclude a strong competitor after inspecting OOD
strict_pass: All three model initialization seeds separately improve >=10% over strongest eligible nonprivileged conventional comparator on each of three disjoint DEV OOD source cohorts (9/9 seed x cohort comparisons).
Paired 5000-replicate 95% bootstrap lower bound of relative improvement >0 per seed/cohort using worlds as resampling unit; positive bounds cannot replace failed point estimate.
On each cohort wrong-action-credit learned gate MSE >=1.20 times correctly credited candidate, and FIT-rate-matched random write MSE >=1.15 times candidate.
Cold state resumed at a midway point produces bitwise identical future state and prediction to continuous stream, including across true changes.
No OOD leakage, no time/index-only shortcut, no hidden-role annotation access and no memory-budget overrun.

Full training cost, resource use, static weights and persistent-state counts disclosed; if strongest baseline compute is not reasonably comparable, report performance-only DEV evidence rather than equal-compute superiority.
Any source, convergence, data custody, registered negative, memory parity or budget failure is STRICT DEV_FAIL; no selective subset PASS.
outcome.science_extension: Requires independent post-freeze real/externally qualified causal environment, witnessed source birth and consumption ledger, separately authorized first-use, fully trained control set, independent seeds/splits, exact-source full regression and objective science acceptance.

infrastructure.workflows: do not dispatch or rerun as an outcome of protocol freezing
